text: 88API Image Studio 是面向 DSH 的图像生成插件，通过三个工具接入图像生成、模型管理和密钥配置。它统一调用 88API 的六种 Image2、Image 2.5 与 Nano Banana 模型，支持文字生成、参考图编辑、比例与分辨率选择、重复生成和顺序提示词批次；生成图保存到本地，并可在条件满足时附加到 DSH 结果。适合需要在 DSH 会话中创作或编辑图像的用户。使用前需配置 88API Key；默认模型和密钥配置保存在本机配置文件。

88API Image Studio is a DSH plugin for generating and editing images through six Image2, Image 2.5, and Nano Banana models. It supports prompts, local reference images, aspect and resolution choices, and sequential batches. Images are saved locally; an 88API key is required.

88API Image Studio 的功能「文生图与编辑」：image_generate_88api 根据提示词生成图像；提供有序本地参考图时转为编辑请求，并支持指定模型、画幅和分辨率。
88API Image Studio 的功能「批量生成」：可重复同一提示词，或按顺序提交多条提示词；每项单独发起请求，批次遇到失败会结束。
88API Image Studio 的功能「模型目录与默认值」：image_model_88api 可列出模型、读取当前默认模型，并在用户要求时保存长期默认值；单次生成也能单独指定模型。
88API Image Studio 的功能「图片结果保存」：生成的图片解码后保存到配置的输出目录，并返回路径、格式、大小和摘要；可用时也附加到 DSH 工具结果。

dsh-plugin-88api-image README · 88API Image Studio for DeepSeek Harness：[中文](README.zh.md) | English

One image studio replaces separate Image2 and Nano Banana plugins. Generate and edit images in DSH with six 88api.ai models, text-to-image, ordered multi-reference editing, 2K/4K output, sequential batches, and a persistent default model—all behind one Key and one install.

88API Image Studio exposes three model-facing tools:

dsh-plugin-88api-image README · 88API Image Studio for DeepSeek Harness：- `image_generate_88api` generates or edits images.
- `image_model_88api` lists models, reads the current default, or changes that default after an explicit user request.
- `image_key_88api` inspects, saves, or clears the Key when a user explicitly asks the Agent to configure it.

The plugin follows the current DSH/Cordis bundle contract. It does not depend on the draft Community Fabric manifest.

dsh-plugin-88api-image README · Models and routing：| Model | Family | Protocol | Resolution |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `gpt-image-2` | Image2 | OpenAI Images API | fixed 2K |
| `gpt-image-2-4k` | Image2 | OpenAI Images API | fixed 4K |
| `gpt-image-2.5-flare` | Image 2.5 | OpenAI Images API | plugin 2K preset |
| `gpt-image-2.5-sunburst` | Image 2.5 | OpenAI Images API | plugin 2K preset |
| `gemini-3.1-flash-image` | Nano Banana | OpenAI Chat Completions | 1K / 2K / 4K |
| `gemini-3-pro-image` | Nano Banana | OpenAI Chat Completions | 1K / 2K / 4K |

dsh-plugin-88api-image README · Models and routing：The two Image 2.5 IDs and Images API route were verified against the 88API live catalog on 2026-09-10. They reuse the plugin 2K size presets; this is not an upstream resolution limit. Select either exact ID for one call or save it as your default.

The factory default is `gpt-image-2`. A saved user default overrides it. A model supplied for one generation overrides the default only for that call. The plugin never silently switches models, providers, or protocols.

dsh-plugin-88api-image README · Install：Install from GitHub into the profile you actually use:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:blackdm666/dsh-plugin-88api-image
```

For DSH Desktop, replace `web` with the active Desktop profile name when needed. For reproducible installations, pin a reviewed commit:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:blackdm666/dsh-plugin-88api-image#<commit-sha>
```

This repository ships runnable JavaScript, so a GitHub install does not need a `prepare` build or pnpm `allowBuilds` permission.

dsh-plugin-88api-image README · Install：Verify the bundle layer before booting:

```sh
dsh --profile web --dump-config
```

The dump should contain the `88api-image` row.

dsh-plugin-88api-image README · Configure the Key: recommended safe method：Run this complete command:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web exec 88api-image set-key
```

> **Do not paste the Key yet and do not replace any command text. This complete command only opens Key setup; no part of it is the Key.**

Follow these steps in order:
section: Configure the Key: recommended safe method

text:
dsh-plugin-88api-image README · Configure the Key: recommended safe method：1. Run the complete `dsh plugin --profile web exec 88api-image set-key` command unchanged, then press Enter once.
2. Wait for the terminal to display `88API Key:` on a separate line.
3. Only then paste the real Key and press Enter again. Hidden input is expected.
section: Configure the Key: recommended safe method

text: dsh-plugin-88api-image README · Configure the Key: recommended safe method：`dsh plugin` invokes plugin management, `--profile web` selects the profile, `exec` runs an installed command, `88api-image` is this plugin's CLI, and `set-key` enters Key setup mode. Replace only `web` when a different profile is active; never replace `88api-image`, `set-key`, or another command part with the Key.
section: Configure the Key: recommended safe method

text:
dsh-plugin-88api-image README · Configure the Key: recommended safe method：After running it, the terminal displays `88API Key:`. Paste the real Key only at that prompt and press Enter. Input is hidden and the complete Key does not enter the command-line arguments.

For non-interactive setup, pipe the Key through standard input:

```sh
printf '%s' "$API88_KEY" | dsh plugin --profile web exec 88api-image set-key --stdin
```

Inspect the masked configuration:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web exec 88api-image config
```
section: Configure the Key: recommended safe method

text: dsh-plugin-88api-image README · Configure the Key: recommended safe method：The default config file is `~/.dsh/88api-image/config.json`. `API88_KEY` overrides the saved Key without writing it to disk. Never commit, paste into an issue, or pass a real Key as a command-line argument.
section: Configure the Key: recommended safe method

text:
dsh-plugin-88api-image README · Configure the Key: ask the Agent to do it：A beginner may say:

```text
My 88API Key is <paste the real Key here>. Save it with image_key_88api. Do not repeat the complete Key; report only the masked preview and whether setup succeeded.
```

The Agent calls `image_key_88api` with `action=set`; the result contains only a masked preview such as `abcdef...1234`.
section: Configure the Key: ask the Agent to do it

text: dsh-plugin-88api-image README · Configure the Key: ask the Agent to do it：**Privacy warning:** this is convenient, but a Key sent to the Agent may remain in DSH conversation and tool-call history. Hidden terminal input is recommended for long-term personal use. If a Key was posted in chat, consider deleting that session or rotating the Key in the 88api.ai console afterward.

section: Choose and change the default model

text: dsh-plugin-88api-image README · Choose and change the default model：The Agent may call `set_default` only when the user explicitly asks for a long-term change. Ordinary generations omit the model and use the saved default exactly.

text: dsh-plugin-88api-image README · Generation and editing：Image2 uses `/v1/images/generations` or `/v1/images/edits`. Nano Banana always uses `/v1/chat/completions` with `modalities: ["text", "image"]` and `extra_body.google.image_config`.

dsh-plugin-88api-image README · Generation and editing：Generated files are saved under `~/Pictures/88api-image` by default. If the active DSH model declares image input and an attachment service is mounted, the plugin also attaches the generated image to the tool result. Otherwise it returns the absolute saved path without injecting an image into a text-only model route.

dsh-plugin-88api-image README · Cost and retry safety：Each `count` or `prompts` item is an independent paid request. Batches run sequentially and stop on the first failure.

Errors marked `[NO-AUTO-RETRY]` mean the request was accepted or its cloud state is unknown. The plugin never automatically retries such a request or falls back to another model. Report the possible charge and wait for explicit user authorization before submitting a new paid request.

dsh-plugin-88api-image README · Security model：DSH plugins run as trusted local code in the Host process; capability metadata is not a sandbox. Review the source and pin a commit before installation. This plugin:

dsh-plugin-88api-image README · Current scope：Version 0.1 focuses on unified text-to-image, multi-reference editing, repeated outputs, sequential prompt batches, dry runs, persistent model selection, and DSH attachment rendering. It does not yet port the older Codex-only SSE preview, folder/template workflow, repair-pass, or nail stress-test commands.

dsh-plugin-88api-image README · Development：```sh
npm install
npm run check
npm run self-test
```

The test suite uses only local mock servers and never calls a paid 88API endpoint. CI also packs the bundle, installs the tarball into a clean DSH profile, and verifies the composed config.
